# Paths whose change makes the operator-substrate workflow run its suites.
#
# This file replaces the `on.pull_request.paths` filter the workflow used to
# carry. The filter had to go because a path-filtered workflow does not report
# a check on PRs it skips, and a required check that never reports strands the
# PR at "Expected". operator-substrate is required on main (2026-09-09 code
# review, top action item 1), so the workflow now triggers on every PR and
# decides INSIDE the job whether the suites need to run, using this list.
#
# Consumers (both must agree; bin/tests/test_ci_coverage_conformance.py pins it):
#   - operator/bin/substrate-paths-changed.py, the detect step in the workflow
#   - operator/bin/tests/test_ci_coverage_conformance.py, which asserts every
#     operator test file falls under one of these patterns
#
# Glob shapes: `dir/**` (prefix), an exact file, or single-`*` segments.
# One pattern per line. Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.

operator/adapter/**
operator/bin/**
operator/safety-substrate/**
operator/connectors/**
# EFF-05: a customer.yaml-only change must trigger the block-conformance
# gate (test_customer_yaml_block_conformance.py); otherwise an unclassified
# top-level block added to only a customer.yaml merges without the gate.
operator/customers/**
# #1688 (2026-07-04 review): whole-directory coverage. The prior filter
# named 4 contract files, Dockerfile, and bootstrap.sh, so skill bodies,
# vertical packs, migrations, the broker, templates/tests, and the
# migration tests could all change without this workflow running.
operator/contracts/**
# ss#2389: the shadow firm. Its scope guard is the mechanism that keeps an
# adversarial scenario off a client seat, so a change to a scenario file
# must run the guard's tests, not only a change to the tests themselves.
operator/rehearsal/**
operator/templates/**
operator/skills/**
operator/verticals/**
operator/migrations/**
operator/workspace_broker/**
# ss#2613: the chronology-package runner. Its tests need the connector
# client's deps, so it runs in its own venv step; a runner change must run it.
operator/runners/**
operator/tests/**
operator/pytest.ini
# The lint config itself: narrowing the rule selection must re-run the gate
# it narrows.
operator/ruff.toml
# The workflow, this list, and the detect script: a change to the mechanism
# runs the mechanism.
.github/workflows/operator-substrate.yml
.github/operator-substrate-paths.txt
